sessions.context: Taylor reasons through and selects a halfway-open sunroof.

turns.speaker: co_user
turns.text: So, a bit of background before I even get to what I was thinking about with the roof thing… When I first bought this car, my brother made fun of me because I spent an entire weekend just reading the manual instead of actually driving it. I learned all about the lights, the seats, even how to reset the tire pressure sensor, but I kind of skimmed that section about the top part that slides back because it was late and I was distracted by a documentary playing in the background. Anyway, now when I'm driving, especially on these mild days where it's not too hot and not too cold, I keep thinking it would be nice if that part up there wasn't so wide open that it messes up my hair, but also not completely shut like when it's raining. I was fiddling with the button earlier and I think I overdid it, and now I'm not sure if I like where it's at.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: It sounds like you're talking about the sunroof and trying to find a comfortable partially-open position—enough airflow without the full wind blast. Right now you're mostly describing how you feel about it, but not exactly how much you want it open. I can adjust it for you to a specific opening percentage. For example, some people like something modest like 20–30% for a gentle breeze, others prefer it halfway at 50%. If you tell me exactly how far you want that top part open—like a percentage between 0 and 100—I can set it there for you.
